artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Apostolicae Sedis 15 (1923), pp. 573-582. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. The web dating clause reads MDCCCCXVIII although the contemporary AAS 15 (1923) act and index identify 12 November 1923. The web transcription error is preserved and not treated as a new date for the act.
artifacts.rights_basis: Original historical wording identified in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 15 (1923), pp. 573-582, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304 and 305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) receives only the remainder of that term. The preexisting wording remains distinct from modern HTML, creative revision and translations under 103(b).
